lines: One hundred and six Hegemony soldiers fell. One hundred and twenty-two from Concord.
Three hundred and thirty-six lie wounded. A thirty-bed field hospital opens tomorrow.
Meet the last man from Day one.
Cyril Doc Zaboravljeni signed up on the first morning. They gave him a rifle, a spade and a number.
His mother writes every Sunday. He draws his friends in the margins when he writes back.
On Day eleven, raiders cut the wire in the night. He was hit and carried to the hospital. He came back.
Yesterday he won a bet at R F twelve. Two enemy soldiers went down.
Lance corporal now. Four medals. Seventeen days, and he is still here.
Forty-six new soldiers came up the line. Two thousand three hundred and thirty-eight hold it now.
Pick a side. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD, and your soldier joins the war.
